title: StateMirror: Pre-Execution Detection of Hallucinated Tool Calls in Coding Agents
title_zh: StateMirror：编码智能体中幻觉工具调用的执行前检测

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM)-based coding agents may propose invalid actions that are not applicable in the execution environment, such as accessing non-existent paths or missing packages. We term this mismatch hallucinated tool use . A preliminary study of 4,398 agent trajectories reveals that these hallucinations are pervasive and costly, requiring a median of 3 additional interaction steps and 22.4K tokens to recover. Existing frameworks rely on reactive, post-execution feedback, wasting runtime resources. Nevertheless, since an agent’s execution environment is grounded in concrete codebase and harness components, many action prerequisites can be extracted and validated prior to execution.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的编码智能体可能会提出在执行环境中不可应用的无效动作，例如访问不存在的路径或缺失的软件包。 我们将这种不匹配称为幻觉式工具使用。 对 4,398 条智能体轨迹的初步研究表明，这类幻觉普遍存在且代价高昂，恢复它们平均需要额外的 3 个交互步骤和 22.4K 个 token。 现有框架依赖于执行后的被动反馈，浪费了运行时资源。 然而，由于智能体的执行环境建立在具体的代码库与运行框架组件之上，许多动作的前提条件可以在执行之前被提取并加以验证。

sents.en: Nevertheless, since an agent’s execution environment is grounded in concrete codebase and harness components, many action prerequisites can be extracted and validated prior to execution.

paragraphs.en: To this end, we introduce StateMirror , a lightweight pre-execution detector. StateMirror intercepts actions at the harness boundary, extracts state predicates via AST and command analysis, and deterministically validates them against the live repository. By pinpointing exact environment mismatches before execution, StateMirror preempts invalid actions and subsequent recovery cycles. Evaluation on 2,508 actions shows StateMirror achieves 0.940 precision and 0.817 F1 in detecting such hallucinations, surpassing the strongest LLM judge by 35.3% in F1 while reducing median detection latency from 17.73 s to 1.50 ms with zero token consumption. For practical mitigation, StateMirror ’s pre-execution feedback enables agents to rectify over 95% of hallucinated tool calls. During live mitigation on 79 tasks, StateMirror reduces agent execution time by 15.8% and token consumption by 11.8% while maintaining task resolution.
paragraphs.zh: 为此，我们提出了 StateMirror，一个轻量级的执行前检测器。 StateMirror 在 harness 边界拦截动作，通过 AST 与命令分析提取状态谓词，并针对实时仓库确定性地验证这些谓词。 通过在执行前精确定位环境不匹配，StateMirror 预先阻止无效动作及其后续的恢复循环。 在 2,508 个动作上的评估显示，StateMirror 在检测此类幻觉方面达到 0.940 的精确率和 0.817 的 F1，比最强的 LLM 评审高出 35.3% 的 F1，同时将中位检测延迟从 17.73 秒降至 1.50 毫秒，且零 token 消耗。 在实际缓解方面，StateMirror 的执行前反馈使智能体能够纠正超过 95% 的幻觉性工具调用。 在 79 个任务的实时缓解过程中，StateMirror 在保持任务解决率的同时，将智能体执行时间减少了 15.8%，token 消耗减少了 11.8%。

paragraphs.en: Modern coding agents solve software engineering tasks by iteratively interacting with their environments ( Wang et al., 2025b ; Bouzenia et al., 2025 ) . These agents typically follow the reasoning-and-acting (ReAct) paradigm ( Yao et al., 2022 ) , using tool calls to inspect repository contents, modify files, and run tests. However, these actions often lack grounding in the workspace, leading to failures such as referencing invalid filesystem paths, missing modules, or undefined symbols.
paragraphs.zh: 现代编码智能体通过与其环境迭代交互来解决软件工程任务（Wang et al., 2025b；Bouzenia et al., 2025）。 这些智能体通常遵循推理与行动（ReAct）范式（Yao et al., 2022），使用工具调用来检查仓库内容、修改文件和运行测试。 然而，这些行动往往缺乏对工作区的感知，从而导致诸如引用无效的文件系统路径、缺失的模块或未定义的符号等失败情况。

paragraphs.en: We define this failure mode as hallucinated tool use , occurring when an agent’s proposed action violates preconditions imposed by the actual environment ( Hoare, 1969 ; Meyer, 1992 ) . Unlike reasoning flaws or semantic code bugs that execute successfully but fail the task, hallucinated tool use embeds invalid references (e.g., non-existent entities) into tool calls, making them fundamentally unexecutable as intended. Figure 1 illustrates two hallucinated tool uses: (a) assumes an unexported symbol within a target namespace, (b) misinterprets the filesystem layout.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将这种失败模式定义为「幻觉式工具使用」，即当智能体提出的动作违反了实际环境所施加的前置条件时发生（Hoare, 1969；Meyer, 1992）。 与推理缺陷或语义代码错误（它们能成功执行但无法完成任务）不同，幻觉式工具使用会将无效引用（例如不存在的实体）嵌入到工具调用中，使其从根本上无法按预期执行。 图 1 展示了两种幻觉式工具使用：(a) 假设了目标命名空间中存在一个未被导出的符号，(b) 误解了文件系统布局。

paragraphs.en: To understand the impact of hallucinated tool use, we conduct a preliminary study analyzing 4,398 SWE-agent trajectories on SWE-bench-Extra ( Nebius, 2024b ; Yang et al., 2024 ) , identifying 9,595 hallucinated tool calls across 120,801 total calls. Our study reveals three key findings. First, hallucinated tool use is pervasive , occurring in 46.6% of failed and 32.3% of resolved trajectories. Second, recovering from these hallucinations is costly . When a hallucinated tool call fails (e.g., with a ModuleNotFoundError ), the agent may take several steps before reaching a grounded retry, incurring a median recovery cost of 3 steps and 22.4K tokens. Furthermore, 30.3% of these hallucinations never reach a successful grounded retry. Third, their root causes are concentrated : filesystem mismatches (such as missing files or paths) account for 43.3% of the cases, and namespace mismatches (such as missing modules or undefined symbols) account for 41.9%. This concentration of verifiable error types indicates that most hallucinations can be validated before the step proceeds, thereby avoiding costly post-failure recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 为了理解幻觉式工具调用的影响，我们开展了一项初步研究，分析了 SWE-bench-Extra 上的 4,398 条 SWE-agent 轨迹（Nebius, 2024b; Yang et al., 2024），在总计 120,801 次工具调用中识别出 9,595 次幻觉式工具调用。 我们的研究揭示了三个关键发现。 第一，幻觉式工具调用普遍存在，出现在 46.6% 的失败轨迹和 32.3% 的已解决轨迹中。 第二，从这些幻觉中恢复的代价很高。 当一次幻觉式工具调用失败时（例如出现 ModuleNotFoundError），智能体可能需要经过若干步骤才能进行一次基于真实环境的重试，其恢复成本中位数为 3 个步骤和 22.4K 个 token。 此外，30.3% 的这类幻觉始终未能达成一次成功的基于真实环境的重试。 第三，其根本原因高度集中：文件系统不匹配（如文件或路径缺失）占 43.3% 的案例，命名空间不匹配（如模块缺失或符号未定义）占 41.9%。 这种可验证错误类型的集中表明，大多数幻觉可以在该步骤继续之前得到验证，从而避免代价高昂的事后恢复。

paragraphs.en: However, existing approaches are not designed for such pre-execution grounding. They primarily target high-level inference flaws and often overlook tool hallucinations caused by inconsistencies with the execution environment. Some methods detect reasoning failures only through post-execution feedback ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Fan et al., 2023 ) , incurring runtime overhead after the erroneous action has already been executed. Others rely on LLM-based judges over execution histories ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , which introduce additional inference cost and may suffer from reasoning biases ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 然而，现有方法并非为这种执行前落地（grounding）而设计。 它们主要针对高层推理缺陷，往往忽视了由与执行环境不一致所导致的工具幻觉。 一些方法仅通过执行后的反馈来检测推理失败（Shinn et al., 2023；Chen et al., 2024；Fan et al., 2023），从而在错误动作已经执行之后才产生运行时开销。 另一些方法依赖基于大语言模型（LLM）的裁判对执行历史进行评判（Zhang et al., 2026），这会引入额外的推理成本，并可能受到推理偏差的影响（Zheng et al., 2023）。

paragraphs.en: To address this gap, we present StateMirror , a lightweight detector that catches proposed hallucinated tool use before it proceeds. Because tool preconditions are grounded in verifiable environment artifacts, such as the repository codebase and runtime harness, we can validate them statically without executing the action. Specifically, StateMirror intercepts actions at the harness boundary and verifies their preconditions through a two-step process. First, a predicate extractor statically parses the proposed action to derive typed state predicates, such as importable or symbol_defined . Second, a read-only prober deterministically checks these predicates against the live execution environment. If any predicate is violated, StateMirror returns a typed warning detailing the exact mismatch. Operating deterministically without LLM invocation, StateMirror consumes no tokens, incurs minimal latency, and preempts costly post-execution recovery cycles.
paragraphs.zh: 为弥补这一空白，我们提出了 StateMirror，一个轻量级检测器，可在提议的幻觉工具使用继续执行之前将其捕获。 由于工具前置条件锚定于可验证的环境工件，例如代码仓库和运行时测试框架，我们可以在不执行动作的情况下对其进行静态验证。 具体而言，StateMirror 在测试框架边界处拦截动作，并通过两步过程验证其前置条件。 首先，谓词提取器静态解析所提议的动作，推导出带类型的状态谓词，例如 importable 或 symbol_defined。 其次，只读探测器在实时执行环境中确定性地检查这些谓词。 若有任何谓词被违反，StateMirror 会返回一条带类型的警告，详细说明确切的不匹配之处。 StateMirror 以确定性方式运行且无需调用大语言模型，不消耗任何 token，引入的延迟极低，并能抢在代价高昂的执行后恢复循环之前阻止错误发生。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate StateMirror on a benchmark of 2,508 expert-labeled actions from 1,197 public failed trajectories of four agent frameworks with different harness designs: SWE-agent, OpenHands, Sonar, and Honeycomb. Following the annotation workflow of our preliminary study, we retrieve candidate actions via failure keywords and tracebacks, replay prior edits to reconstruct the exact pre-action workspace, and have annotators label each action independently. StateMirror achieves a hallucination detection precision of 0.940 and an F1 score of 0.817, exceeding the strongest LLM judge by 0.213 F1 and a scaffold linter by 0.772 F1. Furthermore, StateMirror is also fast and cheap to run, completing each detection in a median of 1.50 ms with no token cost.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在一个包含 2,508 条专家标注动作的基准上评估 StateMirror，这些动作来自四个采用不同框架设计的智能体框架的 1,197 条公开失败轨迹：SWE-agent、OpenHands、Sonar 和 Honeycomb。 遵循初步研究的标注流程，我们通过失败关键词和回溯信息检索候选动作，重放先前的编辑以重建动作发生前的精确工作区，并由标注者独立标注每个动作。 StateMirror 实现了 0.940 的幻觉检测精确率和 0.817 的 F1 分数，超过最强的 LLM 评判器 0.213 F1，超过脚手架检查器 0.772 F1。 此外，StateMirror 运行快速且成本低廉，每次检测的中位耗时仅为 1.50 ms，且无 token 开销。

paragraphs.en: Interactive coding agents complete software engineering tasks by combining reasoning and tool use. This process typically follows the ReAct paradigm ( Yao et al., 2022 ) . In this loop, the agent generates a structured action, the environment executes it, and the harness returns an observation. Various agent runtimes and repair systems operate within this paradigm by translating model outputs into environment commands ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Bouzenia et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) . Additionally, prior studies investigate different formats for these actions, such as direct code execution or standardized JSON schemas ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2023 ) . While earlier models focus on simple API invocation ( Schick et al., 2023 ; Patil et al., 2024 ; Qin et al., 2024 ) , software-engineering agents automate complex tasks like test generation and behavior recovery ( Ruan et al., 2025 ; Kang et al., 2023 ) . However, integrating and running these agents in real-world systems remains highly challenging ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2025 ) . Our work focuses specifically on the tool-use loop of these coding agents. We analyze the proposed tool calls and their arguments rather than the internal reasoning of the model.
paragraphs.zh: 交互式编码智能体通过结合推理与工具使用来完成软件工程任务。 这一过程通常遵循 ReAct 范式（Yao et al., 2022）。 在该循环中，智能体生成一个结构化的动作，环境执行该动作，然后运行框架返回一个观察结果。 各类智能体运行时与修复系统都在该范式内运作，将模型输出转换为环境命令（Yang et al., 2024；Bouzenia et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2024）。 此外，先前的研究还探索了这些动作的不同格式，例如直接代码执行或标准化的 JSON 模式（Wang et al., 2024；Yang et al., 2023）。 早期的模型侧重于简单的 API 调用（Schick et al., 2023；Patil et al., 2024；Qin et al., 2024），而软件工程智能体则能自动化诸如测试生成与行为恢复等复杂任务（Ruan et al., 2025；Kang et al., 2023）。 然而，将这些智能体集成到真实系统中并加以运行仍然极具挑战性（Chen et al., 2025；Lu et al., 2025）。 我们的工作专门聚焦于这些编码智能体的工具使用循环。 我们分析的是所提出的工具调用及其参数，而非模型的内部推理。

paragraphs.en: In axiomatic semantics of programs, pre- and post-condition reasoning is concerned with checking that on any program input satisfying the precondition P P , the program output should satisfy the postcondition Q Q . For example, the precondition P P may be that an input file exists or that some variable value is positive, and the postcondition Q Q may specify the verification condition that we want to be satisfied. Pre- and post-condition checking underlies many program verification techniques, including static analysis tools such as Dafny ( Leino, 2010 ) or Frama ( Cuoq et al., 2012 ) or dynamic analysis techniques such as runtime monitoring ( Leucker and Schallhart, 2009 ) .

paragraphs.en: We analyze hallucinated tool use through a systematic three-stage workflow consisting of automated screening, human adjudication, and cost replay.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过一个系统化的三阶段工作流来分析幻觉式工具使用，该工作流包括自动筛选、人工裁定和成本重放。

paragraphs.en: We identify and validate hallucinated tool calls in two stages. First, during automated screening, we analyze a public corpus of 80,036 SWE-agent runs ( Nebius, 2024a ) on SWE-bench-Extra ( Nebius, 2024b ) , which spans a broader set of Python repositories than the original SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) . To compare behaviors across different outcomes, we retain one trajectory per issue and outcome, yielding 3,560 failed trajectories (with 107,308 actions) from 1,274 repositories and 838 resolved trajectories (with 13,493 actions) from 491 repositories. From these trajectories, we identify candidate mismatches through two channels: (1) execution failures filtered by deterministic rules and (2) editor command errors rejected directly by the harness. Second, in the human adjudication stage, two co-authors independently annotate these candidates by inspecting the exact workspace state and full trajectory history of each action, resolving disagreements through a third annotator.
paragraphs.zh: 我们分两个阶段识别并验证幻觉工具调用。 首先，在自动筛选阶段，我们分析了一个包含 80,036 次 SWE-agent 运行（Nebius, 2024a）的公开语料库，该语料库基于 SWE-bench-Extra（Nebius, 2024b），其涵盖的 Python 代码库范围比原始的 SWE-bench（Jimenez et al., 2024）更广。 为了比较不同结果下的行为，我们对每个议题和结果各保留一条轨迹，从而得到来自 1,274 个代码库的 3,560 条失败轨迹（包含 107,308 个动作）以及来自 491 个代码库的 838 条已解决轨迹（包含 13,493 个动作）。 我们通过两条渠道从这些轨迹中识别候选的不匹配情况：(1) 经确定性规则过滤的执行失败，以及 (2) 被运行框架直接拒绝的编辑器命令错误。 其次，在人工裁定阶段，两位合著者通过查看每个动作的确切工作区状态和完整轨迹历史来独立标注这些候选样本，并通过第三位标注者来解决分歧。

sents.zh: 其次，在人工裁定阶段，两位合著者通过查看每个动作的确切工作区状态和完整轨迹历史来独立标注这些候选样本，并通过第三位标注者来解决分歧。

paragraphs.en: In total, this process confirms 9,595 hallucinated tool calls in total (4,715 from execution failures and 4,880 from harness rejections), establishing a ground-truth dataset of hallucinated tool calls.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，该过程共确认了 9,595 次幻觉工具调用（其中 4,715 次来自执行失败，4,880 次来自框架拒绝），从而建立了一个幻觉工具调用真实标签数据集。

paragraphs.en: We present the empirical results of our study for each research question.
paragraphs.zh: 我们展示了本研究针对每个研究问题的实证结果。

paragraphs.en: We first measure the prevalence of hallucinated tool uses in real trajectories, defined as the proportion of trajectories that contain at least one hallucinated tool call, separately for failed and resolved runs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先测量真实轨迹中幻觉性工具使用的普遍程度，其定义为包含至少一次幻觉性工具调用的轨迹所占比例，并分别针对失败运行和已解决运行进行统计。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 2 (a), 46.6% of failed trajectories contain at least one hallucinated tool call, compared with 32.3% of resolved trajectories; overall, 1,931 of the 4,398 trajectories (43.9%) are affected. This trend also holds for issues that contain both failed and resolved runs. Among trajectories with hallucinated tool use, failed runs contain 5.3 such calls on average, compared with 3.1 in resolved runs (Figure 2 (b)).
paragraphs.zh: 如图 2 (a) 所示，46.6% 的失败轨迹中包含至少一次幻觉性工具调用，而成功轨迹中这一比例为 32.3%；总体而言，4,398 条轨迹中有 1,931 条（43.9%）受到影响。 这一趋势在同时包含失败运行和成功运行的问题中同样成立。 在存在幻觉性工具使用的轨迹中，失败运行平均包含 5.3 次此类调用，而成功运行为 3.1 次（图 2 (b)）。

sents.zh: 如图 2 (a) 所示，46.6% 的失败轨迹中包含至少一次幻觉性工具调用，而成功轨迹中这一比例为 32.3%；总体而言，4,398 条轨迹中有 1,931 条（43.9%）受到影响。

sents.en: Among trajectories with hallucinated tool use, failed runs contain 5.3 such calls on average, compared with 3.1 in resolved runs (Figure 2 (b)).
sents.zh: 在存在幻觉性工具使用的轨迹中，失败运行平均包含 5.3 次此类调用，而成功运行为 3.1 次（图 2 (b)）。

paragraphs.en: The high prevalence across both failed and resolved runs shows that hallucinated tool use is not limited to unsuccessful trajectories and can arise regardless of the final task outcome. Moreover, hallucinated tool calls can recur within a trajectory, indicating that insufficient environment grounding may persist across agent execution. This creates a clear need to verify tool-use assumptions against the concrete environment before execution.
paragraphs.zh: 幻觉式工具调用在失败和成功的运行轨迹中均广泛存在，这表明幻觉式工具调用并不局限于失败的轨迹，而是无论最终任务结果如何都可能出现。 此外，幻觉式工具调用可能在同一条轨迹中反复出现，这表明环境 grounding 不足的问题可能在智能体执行过程中持续存在。 这清楚地表明，需要在执行之前针对具体环境来验证工具调用所依据的假设。

paragraphs.en: To quantify the execution cost of hallucinated tool calls, we trace the 1,931 trajectories containing at least one confirmed hallucination. We define a hallucination episode as the sequence of actions starting from an initial hallucinated tool call and spanning all subsequent attempts until recovery . Recovery occurs when the agent successfully executes the intended command without error, correctly referencing the target entity (e.g., a module, symbol, or path extracted from the execution feedback). We measure the episode cost in agent steps and tokens, using the cl100k tokenizer ( OpenAI, 2023 ) . In total, we analyze 1,606 episodes originating from commands with an identifiable target entity. We exclude harness-channel hallucinations because agents rarely re-run the same editor command after a harness error.
paragraphs.zh: 为了量化幻觉性工具调用的执行成本，我们追踪了这1,931条至少包含一次确认幻觉的轨迹。 我们将一次幻觉事件定义为从一个初始的幻觉性工具调用开始、涵盖其后所有尝试动作直至恢复为止的动作序列。 当智能体成功无误地执行了预期命令、并正确引用了目标实体（例如从执行反馈中提取的模块、符号或路径）时，即视为发生恢复。 我们以智能体步数和词元数来度量事件成本，使用的是cl100k分词器（OpenAI, 2023）。 总共，我们分析了来自具有可识别目标实体的命令的1,606个事件。 我们排除了harness通道的幻觉，因为智能体在出现harness错误后很少重新运行同一编辑器命令。

paragraphs.en: Hallucinated tool calls impose substantial recovery costs. A recovered episode consumes a median of 3 agent steps and 22.4K tokens before a grounded retry. Across the 1,120 recovered episodes, these attempts consume 39.3M tokens in total. In addition, 30.3% of episodes are never retried after the error; in these cases, agents proceed for a median of 18 subsequent steps and eventually fail the task. Thus, hallucinated tool calls add execution overhead, consuming agent steps and tokens and slowing task completion.
paragraphs.zh: 幻觉式工具调用会带来巨大的恢复成本。 一次恢复的片段在成功落地重试之前，中位数需要消耗 3 个智能体步骤和 22.4K tokens。 在全部 1,120 个恢复的片段中，这些尝试总计消耗 39.3M tokens。 此外，30.3% 的片段在报错后从未重试；在这些情况下，智能体会继续执行中位数 18 个后续步骤，最终导致任务失败。 因此，幻觉式工具调用增加了执行开销，消耗智能体步骤和 tokens，并拖慢任务完成速度。

paragraphs.en: We next examine the types of assumptions violated by the 9,595 confirmed hallucinated tool calls. To derive the categories, two of the co-authors follow an open card-sorting procedure ( Spencer, 2009 ; Zimmermann, 2016 ) : during adjudication, whenever an annotator marks a call as a hallucinated tool call, they also label the category of assumption it violates, introducing a new category when no existing one fits. The two annotators then iteratively compare, merge, and refine their categories into a shared set, as summarized in Table 1 . Over all 9,595 calls, the two annotators reach a Cohen’s κ \kappa of 0.869 (95.6% raw agreement), and the third co-author resolves the remaining disagreements.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来我们考察这 9,595 个已确认的幻觉式工具调用所违反的假设类型。 为了得出这些类别，两位合著者采用开放式卡片分类流程（Spencer, 2009；Zimmermann, 2016）：在裁定过程中，每当标注者将某次调用标记为幻觉式工具调用时，他们还会标注其所违反的假设类别；当没有现有类别适用时，则引入新的类别。 随后，两位标注者迭代地比较、合并并完善各自的类别，形成一套共享的类别体系，总结见表 1。 在全部 9,595 个调用上，两位标注者达到 Cohen's κ \kappa 0.869（原始一致率为 95.6%），剩余的分歧由第三位合著者裁定解决。

paragraphs.en: The distribution is highly concentrated in a small number of categories. As shown in Table 1 , filesystem and Python namespace assumptions account for more than 85% of all confirmed hallucinated tool calls. They also affect a large fraction of trajectories, appearing in 58.2% and 52.7% of them, respectively. paragraphs.en: This concentration has an important implication. Most hallucinated tool calls arise from a small set of concrete properties of the execution environment, such as whether a file exists or whether a Python symbol is available. These properties can be represented as explicit predicates and checked against the execution environment before execution. The limited diversity of violated assumptions therefore makes systematic pre-execution detection practical.

paragraphs.en: StateMirror is a lightweight detector designed to assess action feasibility before execution. As shown in Figure 3 , StateMirror includes four stages: normalization, predicate extraction, environment probing, and reporting. The extractor depends on action syntax, and the prober depends on the workspace and runtime artifacts available at check time. Both components can be extended for new tools or environments without changing these stages.
paragraphs.zh: StateMirror 是一个轻量级检测器，旨在在执行前评估动作可行性。 如图 3 所示，StateMirror 包含四个阶段：规范化、谓词提取、环境探测和报告。 提取器依赖于动作语法，而探测器依赖于检查时可用的_workspace_和运行时产物。 这两个组件都可以在不改变这些阶段的情况下针对新工具或新环境进行扩展。

sents.en: StateMirror is a lightweight detector designed to assess action feasibility before execution.
sents.zh: StateMirror 是一个轻量级检测器，旨在在执行前评估动作可行性。

sents.en: As shown in Figure 3 , StateMirror includes four stages: normalization, predicate extraction, environment probing, and reporting.
sents.zh: 如图 3 所示，StateMirror 包含四个阶段：规范化、谓词提取、环境探测和报告。

sents.zh: 提取器依赖于动作语法，而探测器依赖于检查时可用的_workspace_和运行时产物。

sents.en: Both components can be extended for new tools or environments without changing these stages.
sents.zh: 这两个组件都可以在不改变这些阶段的情况下针对新工具或新环境进行扩展。

paragraphs.en: To handle different forms of agent actions, such as shell commands and structured tool calls, StateMirror normalizes each proposed action into a unified representation for subsequent analysis. This representation captures the action type, current working directory, tool parameters, shell command, and associated Python code. For shell commands that invoke Python scripts (e.g., python reproduce.py ), StateMirror reads the script from the current workspace and includes its source code in the normalized representation when available. This allows subsequent predicate extraction to analyze the code that the harness would execute.
paragraphs.zh: 为了处理不同形式的智能体动作，例如 shell 命令和结构化工具调用，StateMirror 将每个提议的动作归一化为统一表示，以便后续分析。 该表示涵盖动作类型、当前工作目录、工具参数、shell 命令以及相关的 Python 代码。 对于调用 Python 脚本的 shell 命令（例如 python reproduce.py），StateMirror 会从当前工作区读取该脚本，并在可用时将其源代码纳入归一化表示中。 这使得后续的谓词提取能够分析测试框架将要执行的代码。

paragraphs.en: Hallucinated tool use occurs when a proposed action assumes environmental conditions that do not hold in the actual execution environment. To detect such mismatches, StateMirror extracts the implicit assumptions from proposed actions as explicit predicates and verifies them against the current environment by probing into the environment.
paragraphs.zh: 幻觉式工具使用发生在拟议动作假定了在实际执行环境中并不成立的环境条件时。 为了检测这类不匹配，StateMirror 将拟议动作中的隐式假设提取为显式谓词，并通过探测环境来根据当前环境对它们进行验证。

sents.zh: 幻觉式工具使用发生在拟议动作假定了在实际执行环境中并不成立的环境条件时。

sents.en: To detect such mismatches, StateMirror extracts the implicit assumptions from proposed actions as explicit predicates and verifies them against the current environment by probing into the environment.
sents.zh: 为了检测这类不匹配，StateMirror 将拟议动作中的隐式假设提取为显式谓词，并通过探测环境来根据当前环境对它们进行验证。

paragraphs.en: Given a normalized action, StateMirror extracts typed predicates that represent the environmental conditions required for its execution. Depending on the action type, the extractor analyzes shell commands, structured tool parameters, and Python code. For Python code, it parses the source into an abstract syntax tree (AST) on demand to identify relevant operations and their dependencies. Each extracted predicate specifies a concrete requirement, such as the availability of a Python module, the existence of a filesystem path, or the validity of a tool argument. When a required value cannot be determined statically, the corresponding predicate is omitted.
paragraphs.zh: 给定一个归一化动作，StateMirror 会提取出类型化谓词，用以表示该动作执行所需的环境条件。 根据动作类型的不同，提取器会分析 shell 命令、结构化工具参数以及 Python 代码。 对于 Python 代码，它会按需将源代码解析为抽象语法树（AST），以识别相关操作及其依赖关系。 每个提取出的谓词都指定一个具体需求，例如 Python 模块的可用性、文件系统路径的存在性，或工具参数的有效性。 当某个所需的值无法静态确定时，相应的谓词将被省略。

sents.en: Given a normalized action, StateMirror extracts typed predicates that represent the environmental conditions required for its execution.
sents.zh: 给定一个归一化动作，StateMirror 会提取出类型化谓词，用以表示该动作执行所需的环境条件。

sents.en: Depending on the action type, the extractor analyzes shell commands, structured tool parameters, and Python code.
sents.zh: 根据动作类型的不同，提取器会分析 shell 命令、结构化工具参数以及 Python 代码。

sents.en: For Python code, it parses the source into an abstract syntax tree (AST) on demand to identify relevant operations and their dependencies.
sents.zh: 对于 Python 代码，它会按需将源代码解析为抽象语法树（AST），以识别相关操作及其依赖关系。

sents.en: Each extracted predicate specifies a concrete requirement, such as the availability of a Python module, the existence of a filesystem path, or the validity of a tool argument.
sents.zh: 每个提取出的谓词都指定一个具体需求，例如 Python 模块的可用性、文件系统路径的存在性，或工具参数的有效性。

sents.en: When a required value cannot be determined statically, the corresponding predicate is omitted.
sents.zh: 当某个所需的值无法静态确定时，相应的谓词将被省略。

paragraphs.en: For each extracted predicate, StateMirror performs read-only checks against the current execution environment. Depending on the predicate type, these checks inspect the repository structure, Python module definitions, filesystem metadata, runtime information, or harness schemas. A predicate is considered violated when the corresponding environmental requirement is confirmed to be false. When a check cannot reliably determine whether a requirement holds, StateMirror conservatively allows the predicate to pass and records the uncertainty in the probe evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个提取出的谓词，StateMirror 会在当前执行环境中执行只读检查。 根据谓词类型的不同，这些检查会检查仓库结构、Python 模块定义、文件系统元数据、运行时信息或测试框架（harness）模式。 当相应的环境要求被确认为不成立时，该谓词即被视为被违反。 当检查无法可靠地判断某项要求是否成立时，StateMirror 会保守地允许该谓词通过，并将这一不确定性记录在探测证据中。

sents.en: For each extracted predicate, StateMirror performs read-only checks against the current execution environment.
sents.zh: 对于每个提取出的谓词，StateMirror 会在当前执行环境中执行只读检查。

sents.en: Depending on the predicate type, these checks inspect the repository structure, Python module definitions, filesystem metadata, runtime information, or harness schemas.
sents.zh: 根据谓词类型的不同，这些检查会检查仓库结构、Python 模块定义、文件系统元数据、运行时信息或测试框架（harness）模式。

sents.en: A predicate is considered violated when the corresponding environmental requirement is confirmed to be false.
sents.zh: 当相应的环境要求被确认为不成立时，该谓词即被视为被违反。

sents.en: When a check cannot reliably determine whether a requirement holds, StateMirror conservatively allows the predicate to pass and records the uncertainty in the probe evidence.
sents.zh: 当检查无法可靠地判断某项要求是否成立时，StateMirror 会保守地允许该谓词通过，并将这一不确定性记录在探测证据中。

paragraphs.en: Motivated by Finding #3, we organize the extracted predicates into four families: Python namespace and package layout, filesystem and working directory, command and runtime state, and harness and tool schemas. As shown in Figure 4 , these families capture the main types of environmental assumptions identified in our preliminary study. Each family defines specific predicates and corresponding checks to verify these assumptions against the execution environment. StateMirror also supports extensions to new tools and environments by introducing additional predicates and their corresponding extractors and probers.
paragraphs.zh: 受发现3的启发，我们将提取出的谓词组织为四类：Python 命名空间与包布局、文件系统与工作目录、命令与运行时状态，以及测试框架与工具模式。 如图4所示，这些类别涵盖了我们在初步研究中识别出的主要环境假设类型。 每个类别都定义了具体的谓词及相应的检查，以便针对执行环境验证这些假设。 StateMirror 还通过引入额外的谓词及其对应的提取器和探测器，支持对新工具和新环境的扩展。

paragraphs.en: ∙ \bullet Family I: Python Namespace and Package Layout. This family verifies assumptions about Python modules, packages, and exported symbols. Verifying these assumptions is important because missing modules or symbols can cause reproduction scripts and test helpers to fail during execution ( Kang et al., 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: ∙ \bullet 家族一：Python 命名空间与包布局。 该家族验证关于 Python 模块、包和导出符号的假设。 验证这些假设非常重要，因为缺失模块或符号可能导致复现脚本和测试辅助工具在执行期间失败 ( Kang et al., 2023 ) 。

sents.en: ∙ \bullet Family I: Python Namespace and Package Layout.
sents.zh: ∙ \bullet 家族一：Python 命名空间与包布局。

sents.en: This family verifies assumptions about Python modules, packages, and exported symbols.
sents.zh: 该家族验证关于 Python 模块、包和导出符号的假设。

sents.en: Verifying these assumptions is important because missing modules or symbols can cause reproduction scripts and test helpers to fail during execution ( Kang et al., 2023 ) .
sents.zh: 验证这些假设非常重要，因为缺失模块或符号可能导致复现脚本和测试辅助工具在执行期间失败 ( Kang et al., 2023 ) 。

paragraphs.en: Since a module may exist without exposing a requested symbol, StateMirror examines both module availability and namespace contents, including symbols exposed through package re-exports. To identify these requirements, StateMirror parses the AST of the Python code included in the normalized action and extracts predicates such as importable , symbol_defined , and is_package . It then verifies these predicates against the repository structure, standard library, and installed packages by inspecting module definitions and common re-export patterns (e.g., __init__.py ). To limit probing overhead, StateMirror restricts dependency analysis to imports directly referenced in the proposed action or its invoked scripts. Predicates involving names that cannot be resolved statically are omitted.
paragraphs.zh: 由于模块可能存在但未暴露所请求的符号，StateMirror 会同时检查模块的可用性和命名空间的内容，包括通过包重导出（re-export）暴露的符号。 为了识别这些前置条件，StateMirror 解析规范化动作中所包含 Python 代码的 AST，并提取诸如 importable、symbol_defined 和 is_package 等谓词。 然后，StateMirror 通过检查模块定义和常见的重导出模式（例如 __init__.py），对照仓库结构、标准库和已安装的包来验证这些谓词。 为了限制探测开销，StateMirror 将依赖分析限制在提议动作或其调用的脚本中直接引用的导入上。 涉及无法静态解析的名称的谓词会被省略。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 (a) illustrates an example involving a missing Python symbol. The agent proposes a script containing from dvc import DVC . From its AST, StateMirror extracts importable(dvc) and symbol_defined(dvc, DVC) . The prober confirms that the dvc package exists but finds no definition or re-export of DVC in dvc/__init__.py . It therefore evaluates symbol_defined(dvc, DVC) as false . This violated predicate identifies a hallucinated tool call that would otherwise result in an ImportError .
paragraphs.zh: 图4(a)展示了一个涉及缺失 Python 符号的示例。 智能体提出一个包含 from dvc import DVC 的脚本。 StateMirror 从其 AST 中提取 importable(dvc) 和 symbol_defined(dvc, DVC) 。 探测器确认 dvc 包存在，但在 dvc/__init__.py 中没有找到 DVC 的定义或重导出。 因此它将 symbol_defined(dvc, DVC) 判定为 false 。 这个被违反的谓词识别出了一个若不加检查就会导致 ImportError 的幻觉工具调用。

paragraphs.en: ∙ \bullet Family II: Filesystem and Current-Working-Directory State. This family verifies assumptions about filesystem paths and the current working directory (cwd). Such verification is important because agents may repeatedly attempt to access nonexistent paths, wasting execution steps and computational resources on unsuccessful operations and subsequent recovery.
paragraphs.zh: ∙ \bullet 家族二：文件系统与当前工作目录状态。 该家族验证关于文件系统路径和当前工作目录（cwd）的假设。 这种验证非常重要，因为智能体可能会反复尝试访问不存在的路径，从而在不成功的操作及后续恢复上浪费执行步骤和计算资源。

sents.en: ∙ \bullet Family II: Filesystem and Current-Working-Directory State.
sents.zh: ∙ \bullet 家族二：文件系统与当前工作目录状态。

sents.en: This family verifies assumptions about filesystem paths and the current working directory (cwd).
sents.zh: 该家族验证关于文件系统路径和当前工作目录（cwd）的假设。

sents.en: Such verification is important because agents may repeatedly attempt to access nonexistent paths, wasting execution steps and computational resources on unsuccessful operations and subsequent recovery.
sents.zh: 这种验证非常重要，因为智能体可能会反复尝试访问不存在的路径，从而在不成功的操作及后续恢复上浪费执行步骤和计算资源。

paragraphs.en: To identify these mismatches, StateMirror considers both the current cwd and the type of file operation (e.g., reading, writing, or executing a file). Specifically, relative paths are resolved against the current cwd, while different operations impose different requirements. For example, reading or executing a file requires the target to exist, whereas creating a file generally requires an existing parent directory. Accordingly, StateMirror extracts path arguments from shell commands, Python file operations, and editor actions, generating operation-specific predicates such as file_exists and parent_dir_exists . The prober then checks whether the target files or directories exist at the resolved paths. When a path cannot be determined statically, the corresponding predicate is omitted.
paragraphs.zh: 为了识别这些不匹配，StateMirror 同时考虑当前工作目录（cwd）以及文件操作的类型（例如读取、写入或执行文件）。 具体而言，相对路径会基于当前 cwd 进行解析，而不同的操作则有不同的要求。 例如，读取或执行文件要求目标存在，而创建文件通常要求父目录存在。 相应地，StateMirror 从 shell 命令、Python 文件操作和编辑器操作中提取路径参数，生成操作特定的谓词，例如 file_exists 和 parent_dir_exists。 探测器随后检查目标文件或目录是否存在于解析后的路径上。 当某个路径无法静态确定时，相应的谓词将被省略。

sents.en: To identify these mismatches, StateMirror considers both the current cwd and the type of file operation (e.g., reading, writing, or executing a file).
sents.zh: 为了识别这些不匹配，StateMirror 同时考虑当前工作目录（cwd）以及文件操作的类型（例如读取、写入或执行文件）。

sents.en: Accordingly, StateMirror extracts path arguments from shell commands, Python file operations, and editor actions, generating operation-specific predicates such as file_exists and parent_dir_exists .

sents.en: The prober then checks whether the target files or directories exist at the resolved paths.
sents.zh: 探测器随后检查目标文件或目录是否存在于解析后的路径上。

sents.en: When a path cannot be determined statically, the corresponding predicate is omitted.
sents.zh: 当某个路径无法静态确定时，相应的谓词将被省略。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 (b) illustrates a missing script in the current working directory. The agent proposes python reproduce.py with /repo as its cwd. StateMirror resolves the script path and extracts file_exists(/repo/reproduce.py) and parent_dir_exists(/repo) . The prober confirms that /repo exists but finds no reproduce.py at the expected location. Consequently, the first extracted predicate evaluates to false , identifying a hallucinated tool call that would otherwise fail with a FileNotFoundError .
paragraphs.zh: 图 4 (b) 展示了当前工作目录中缺少脚本的情况。 智能体提出运行 python reproduce.py，并以 /repo 作为其工作目录。 StateMirror 解析脚本路径，并提取出 file_exists(/repo/reproduce.py) 和 parent_dir_exists(/repo)。 探测器确认 /repo 存在，但在预期位置未找到 reproduce.py。 因此，第一个提取出的谓词评估为 false，识别出一个幻觉工具调用，否则该调用将以 FileNotFoundError 失败。

sents.zh: 智能体提出运行 python reproduce.py，并以 /repo 作为其工作目录。

sents.zh: StateMirror 解析脚本路径，并提取出 file_exists(/repo/reproduce.py) 和 parent_dir_exists(/repo)。

sents.en: The prober confirms that /repo exists but finds no reproduce.py at the expected location.
sents.zh: 探测器确认 /repo 存在，但在预期位置未找到 reproduce.py。

sents.en: Consequently, the first extracted predicate evaluates to false , identifying a hallucinated tool call that would otherwise fail with a FileNotFoundError .

paragraphs.en: ∙ \bullet Family III: Command, Test, and Runtime State. This family verifies assumptions about command availability, test targets, and runtime requirements. Checking these assumptions before execution can prevent unnecessary command attempts and test runs, reducing the time and resources spent on diagnosing and correcting invalid actions.
paragraphs.zh: ∙ \bullet 族三：命令、测试与运行时状态。 该族验证关于命令可用性、测试目标和运行时要求的假设。 在执行前检查这些假设可以避免不必要的命令尝试和测试运行，减少用于诊断和纠正无效动作的时间与资源。

sents.en: ∙ \bullet Family III: Command, Test, and Runtime State.
sents.zh: ∙ \bullet 族三：命令、测试与运行时状态。

sents.en: This family verifies assumptions about command availability, test targets, and runtime requirements.
sents.zh: 该族验证关于命令可用性、测试目标和运行时要求的假设。

sents.en: Checking these assumptions before execution can prevent unnecessary command attempts and test runs, reducing the time and resources spent on diagnosing and correcting invalid actions.
sents.zh: 在执行前检查这些假设可以避免不必要的命令尝试和测试运行，减少用于诊断和纠正无效动作的时间与资源。

paragraphs.en: To detect these mismatches, StateMirror analyzes shell commands and command-related tool parameters to extract executable names, pytest targets, and explicit runtime-version requirements. It represents these requirements using predicates such as executable_available , pytest_target_exists , and runtime_version_satisfies . The prober then checks executable availability and runtime-version information in the current environment. For pytest targets, it examines the target file and its static AST nodes to check whether the requested test exists.
paragraphs.zh: 为了检测这些不匹配，StateMirror 会分析 shell 命令以及与命令相关的工具参数，以提取可执行文件名称、pytest 目标以及明确的运行时版本要求。 它使用诸如 executable_available、pytest_target_exists 和 runtime_version_satisfies 之类的谓词来表示这些要求。 探测器随后会在当前环境中检查可执行文件的可用性和运行时版本信息。 对于 pytest 目标，它会检查目标文件及其静态 AST 节点，以确认所请求的测试是否存在。

sents.en: To detect these mismatches, StateMirror analyzes shell commands and command-related tool parameters to extract executable names, pytest targets, and explicit runtime-version requirements.
sents.zh: 为了检测这些不匹配，StateMirror 会分析 shell 命令以及与命令相关的工具参数，以提取可执行文件名称、pytest 目标以及明确的运行时版本要求。

sents.en: It represents these requirements using predicates such as executable_available , pytest_target_exists , and runtime_version_satisfies .
sents.zh: 它使用诸如 executable_available、pytest_target_exists 和 runtime_version_satisfies 之类的谓词来表示这些要求。

sents.en: The prober then checks executable availability and runtime-version information in the current environment.
sents.zh: 探测器随后会在当前环境中检查可执行文件的可用性和运行时版本信息。

sents.en: For pytest targets, it examines the target file and its static AST nodes to check whether the requested test exists.
sents.zh: 对于 pytest 目标，它会检查目标文件及其静态 AST 节点，以确认所请求的测试是否存在。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 (c) illustrates a missing pytest target case. The agent proposes an action, pytest test_sqlparse.py::test_tokenize -q , to verify a fix. From the command, StateMirror extracts pytest_target_exists(test_sqlparse.py, test_tokenize) . The prober confirms that test_sqlparse.py exists and inspects its AST for the requested test node. Since no matching function or method is found, the predicate evaluates to false . StateMirror thus identifies the invalid test target before the command is executed.
paragraphs.zh: 图 4 (c) 展示了一个缺失 pytest 目标的案例。 智能体提出一个动作 pytest test_sqlparse.py::test_tokenize -q 来验证修复。 从该命令中，StateMirror 提取出 pytest_target_exists(test_sqlparse.py, test_tokenize)。 探测器确认 test_sqlparse.py 存在，并检查其 AST 以查找所请求的测试节点。 由于未找到匹配的函数或方法，该谓词的求值结果为 false。 因此 StateMirror 在命令执行之前就识别出了无效的测试目标。

sents.zh: 图 4 (c) 展示了一个缺失 pytest 目标的案例。

paragraphs.en: ∙ \bullet Family IV: Harness and Tool Schemas. This family verifies assumptions about tool argument schemas and the current harness state. Invalid tool arguments or unmet harness requirements may cause tool calls to be rejected, resulting in additional agent steps and recovery costs.
paragraphs.zh: ∙ \bullet 族别四：框架与工具模式。 该族别用于验证关于工具参数模式以及当前框架状态的假设。 无效的工具参数或未满足的框架要求可能导致工具调用被拒绝，从而产生额外的智能体步骤与恢复成本。

sents.en: ∙ \bullet Family IV: Harness and Tool Schemas.
sents.zh: ∙ \bullet 族别四：框架与工具模式。

sents.en: This family verifies assumptions about tool argument schemas and the current harness state.
sents.zh: 该族别用于验证关于工具参数模式以及当前框架状态的假设。

sents.en: Invalid tool arguments or unmet harness requirements may cause tool calls to be rejected, resulting in additional agent steps and recovery costs.
sents.zh: 无效的工具参数或未满足的框架要求可能导致工具调用被拒绝，从而产生额外的智能体步骤与恢复成本。

paragraphs.en: To identify these mismatches, StateMirror examines tool argument constraints (e.g., argument counts, types, and formats) and conditions maintained by the harness (e.g., whether a file is currently open and whether a specified line number is valid). Accordingly, StateMirror extracts schema predicates, such as tool_args_valid , and condition-dependent predicates, including tool_path_arg_exists , editor_file_open , editor_line_in_range , and path_absent . The prober then checks these predicates against tool signatures, the filesystem, and information provided by the harness. For file editing tools, StateMirror identifies the currently open file from the preceding tool response. When the required information is unavailable, the corresponding predicate is omitted.
paragraphs.zh: 为了识别这些不匹配情况，StateMirror 会检查工具参数约束（例如参数数量、类型和格式）以及由 harness 维护的条件（例如某个文件当前是否处于打开状态、指定的行号是否有效）。 相应地，StateMirror 提取模式谓词（例如 tool_args_valid），以及依赖条件的谓词（包括 tool_path_arg_exists、editor_file_open、editor_line_in_range 和 path_absent）。 探测器随后会依据工具签名、文件系统以及 harness 提供的信息来检查这些谓词。 对于文件编辑工具，StateMirror 会从先前的工具响应中识别当前打开的文件。 当所需信息不可用时，相应的谓词将被省略。

paragraphs.en: We implement StateMirror as a Python toolkit (5.8K lines of code) that normalizes actions and checks predicates using deterministic, read-only probes. It operates without executing actions or consuming LLM tokens. For runtime evaluation, we integrate it with SWE-agent ( Yang et al., 2024 ) . All experiments run on an Apple M4 Max machine with 36 GB RAM using Docker, executing tasks within their official SWE-bench containers. For offline evaluation, we reconstruct the pre-action workspace by replaying preceding edits and withhold all execution outcomes. We access all LLMs through the OpenRouter API ( OpenRouter, 2024 ) , set the temperature to 0, and use direct import checking by default.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 StateMirror 实现为一个 Python 工具包（5.8K 行代码），它通过确定性的只读探针来规范化动作并检查谓词。 它在不执行动作或不消耗大语言模型词元的情况下运行。 在运行时评估中，我们将其与 SWE-agent（Yang et al., 2024）集成。 所有实验均在一台配备 36 GB 内存并使用 Docker 的 Apple M4 Max 机器上运行，在其官方 SWE-bench 容器内执行任务。 在离线评估中，我们通过重放先前的编辑来重构动作前的工作区，并隐藏所有执行结果。 我们通过 OpenRouter API（OpenRouter, 2024）访问所有大语言模型，将温度设置为 0，并默认使用直接导入检查。

paragraphs.en: The preliminary study establishes a human-adjudicated workflow for recognizing pre-execution hallucinated tool calls in SWE-agent failures. We extend this workflow to publicly available failed trajectories from SWE-agent ( Yang et al., 2024 ) , OpenHands ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , Sonar ( Shariffdeen and SonarSource, 2025 ) , and Honeycomb ( Honeycomb Team, 2024 ) , constructing a benchmark with expert-labeled positives and negatives. Unlike the preliminary study, we build the benchmark exclusively from failed trajectories. Because a hallucinated tool call is defined by the mismatch between the action and its pre-action workspace rather than the final task outcome, its label remains independent of task resolution. We focus on failed runs because execution-failure evidence naturally concentrates there, and our public data sources (OpenHands, Sonar, and Honeycomb) primarily provide failed trajectories. To ensure comprehensive evaluation, RQ4 also separately reports the performance on resolved-run instances collected during the preliminary study.
paragraphs.zh: 该初步研究建立了一个经人工判定的流程，用于识别 SWE-agent 失败案例中执行前产生的幻觉工具调用。 我们将这一流程扩展到 SWE-agent（Yang et al., 2024）、OpenHands（Wang et al., 2025b）、Sonar（Shariffdeen and SonarSource, 2025）和 Honeycomb（Honeycomb Team, 2024）公开的失败轨迹，构建了一个包含专家标注正例与负例的基准。 与初步研究不同，我们仅从失败轨迹构建该基准。 由于幻觉工具调用由动作与其动作前工作区之间的不匹配来定义，而非由任务的最终结果定义，其标签与任务是否解决无关。 我们聚焦于失败运行，因为执行失败的相关证据天然集中于此类运行中，且我们的公开数据来源（OpenHands、Sonar 和 Honeycomb）主要提供失败轨迹。 为确保评估的全面性，RQ4 还单独报告了在初步研究期间收集的已解决运行实例上的性能。

paragraphs.en: Specifically, we harvest 2,687 candidate failure actions across the four agent sources through automated keyword and traceback retrieval. Human annotators independently inspect each candidate to identify hallucinated tool calls, resolving discrepancies through consensus adjudication. To ensure state integrity, we replay prior prefix edits from the base repository commit to reconstruct the workspace immediately before each action. We filter out 12 cases with unrecoverable execution environments and 167 candidate actions whose stated predicates hold in the reconstructed state, ensuring each retained positive represents a genuine pre-action hallucinated tool call.
paragraphs.zh: 具体而言，我们通过自动化的关键词与回溯信息检索，从四个智能体来源中收集了 2,687 个候选失败动作。 人工标注者独立检查每个候选样本以识别幻觉工具调用，并通过共识裁定解决分歧。 为确保状态完整性，我们从基础仓库提交处重放先前的前缀编辑，以在每个动作发生前即刻重建工作区。 我们过滤掉 12 个执行环境无法恢复的案例，以及 167 个所述谓词在重建状态中成立的候选动作，从而确保每个保留的正样本都代表真实的动作前幻觉工具调用。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate StateMirror using the following metrics:
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用以下指标来评估 StateMirror：

paragraphs.en: ∙ \bullet Detection Effectiveness: Precision, recall, F1-score, and Accuracy against ground-truth labels to evaluate hallucination detection performance.
paragraphs.zh: ∙ \bullet 检测有效性：针对真实标签（ground-truth）计算精确率（Precision）、召回率（recall）、F1 分数（F1-score）和准确率（Accuracy），以评估幻觉检测的性能。

paragraphs.en: ∙ \bullet Computational Efficiency: Execution latency (mean, median, p95, p99, and max) and token consumption to quantify pre-execution detection overhead.
paragraphs.zh: ∙ \bullet 计算效率：执行延迟（均值、中位数、p95、p99 和最大值）以及 token 消耗，用于量化执行前检测的开销。

paragraphs.en: ∙ \bullet Mitigation Performance: We measure two aspects: (1) action repair rate, which is the proportion of warned actions successfully replaced by the agent to clear the gap, and (2) intervention efficiency, which measures the savings in agent time, steps, and tokens per task achieved by blocking actions that would otherwise fail on execution. We also report the task resolve rate to verify that these savings preserve task success.
paragraphs.zh: ∙ \bullet 缓解性能：我们测量两个方面：(1) 动作修复率，即智能体在被警告后成功替换动作以消除差距的比例；(2) 干预效率，即通过阻断原本会在执行时失败的动作，在每个任务上为智能体节省的时间、步骤和 token 数量。 我们还报告任务解决率，以验证这些节省不会损害任务的成功率。

paragraphs.en: To benchmark the detection performance and efficiency of StateMirror , we compare it against three baseline families representing alternative pre-execution detection paradigms:
paragraphs.zh: 为了对 StateMirror 的检测性能与效率进行基准测试，我们将其与代表三种替代性预执行检测范式的基线方法族进行比较：

paragraphs.en: ∙ \bullet LLM Judges: State-of-the-art reasoning models (Qwen3.7 Plus ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , Kimi K3 ( Team, 2026 ) , and Codex 5.6 Sol ( OpenAI, 2026 ) ) configured to predict hallucinated tool calls via zero-shot prompting in the LLM-as-a-judge setting ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) . paragraphs.en: Table 3 compares StateMirror against baseline approaches. We observe that conventional approaches struggle with the trade-off between coverage and grounding. paragraphs.en: We further analyze the failure cases of StateMirror , as detailed in Table 4 . The 390 false negatives are heavily concentrated in the pre-execution action extraction layer rather than state probing logic, with code extraction, command extraction, and selected-file reconstruction accounting for 73.8% (288/390) of misses. These misses primarily stem from implicit preconditions omitted by the action extractors, including library-call arguments, CLI options, and unmaterialized test files, which account for Honeycomb’s higher FN count (209 misses). Across predicate families, symbol predicates achieve the highest recall (0.802), while import (0.703) and file/path (0.736) capture the vast majority of positive hallucinated tool calls. Conversely, false positives remain low across all sources (64 total, spanning 6 to 31 per source), predominantly caused by files generated at run time by the action or an earlier step, path-like string literals, and transient environment state absent during offline static reconstruction.

paragraphs.en: While our primary evaluation relies on the main benchmark of failed trajectories, evaluating StateMirror on successful runs is crucial to assess its generalizability. We therefore apply StateMirror to the resolved stratum from our preliminary study. This dataset contains 823 expert-confirmed hallucinated tool calls as positives and 43 rejected candidates as hard negatives. On this stratum, StateMirror achieves 0.989 precision, 0.532 recall, and 0.692 F1, detecting at least one hallucinated tool call in 81.5% of the trajectories. The lower recall compared to the main benchmark is primarily due to dynamic runtime attribute errors and temporary files created during execution, which fall outside our static predicate vocabulary. When excluding these dynamic cases, StateMirror detects the remaining static, in-vocabulary screened hallucinations with 79.1% recall (254/321). Similarly, it achieves 92.1% recall (164/178) on harness-error calls when excluding run-time file creation retries.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然我们的主要评估依赖于以失败轨迹为主的数据集，但在成功运行的场景上评估 StateMirror 对于考察其泛化能力同样至关重要。 因此，我们将 StateMirror 应用于初步研究中已解决的层级。 该数据集包含 823 条经专家确认的幻觉工具调用作为正例，以及 43 条被拒绝的候选调用作为困难负例。 在该层级上，StateMirror 达到了 0.989 的精确率、0.532 的召回率和 0.692 的 F1 值，在 81.5% 的轨迹中检测到至少一次幻觉工具调用。 相比主要基准数据集召回率较低，其主要原因在于动态运行时属性错误以及执行过程中创建的临时文件，它们超出了我们静态谓词词表的范围。 在排除这些动态案例后，StateMirror 对其余属于静态、词表范围内的可筛查幻觉的检测召回率为 79.1%（254/321）。 类似地，在排除运行时文件创建重试后，它在 harness 错误调用上的召回率为 92.1%（164/178）。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate the individual contributions of different predicate families, we perform both cumulative addition and leave-one-out ablation studies of StateMirror . Starting from core namespace and symbol checks, we incrementally introduce and systematically isolate each predicate family to quantify its marginal impact on precision, recall, F1-score and accuracy.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估不同谓词族各自的贡献，我们对 StateMirror 进行了累加式添加和留一法消融实验。 从核心命名空间和符号检查开始，我们逐步引入并系统隔离每个谓词族，以量化其对精确率、召回率、F1 分数和准确率的边际影响。

paragraphs.en: Table 6 summarizes the ablation results. Namespace and package-layout predicates (Family I) provide the high-precision foundation, identifying 752 true positives with 0.972 precision and 0.691 F1; correspondingly, omitting this family in the leave-one-out setting causes the sharpest degradation, collapsing F1 to 0.323. Filesystem and cwd predicates (Family II) produce the primary recall expansion, recovering 224 additional true positives and raising recall from 0.537 to 0.697 (0.801 F1), while removing them reduces F1 to 0.711. Harness and tool-schema predicates (Family IV) contribute 34 additional true positives at the cost of three false positives, elevating overall F1 to 0.817 (and removing them lowers F1 to 0.801). Command, test, and runtime predicates (Family III) add a single true positive, an absent pytest node, because this benchmark contains few command-level hallucinations. paragraphs.en: To evaluate whether tracing repository-local dependencies beyond direct predicates improves detection, we investigate bounded multi-hop probing across the 2,508 benchmark actions. paragraphs.en: We investigate how effectively StateMirror mitigates detected hallucinated tool calls within agent workflows, at two levels with recovery instructions (as illustrated in Figure 5 ). Action repair asks whether a typed warning lets the agent replace the faulty action with a valid one, under both controlled revision and live agent execution. Pre-execution intervention asks whether blocking the faulty action before it runs removes the downstream cost the hallucination would otherwise cause over the rest of the task. We run StateMirror in two modes: report mode , which logs every warning without blocking, and intervention mode , which applies a conservative blocking rule. In intervention mode, StateMirror blocks an action and prompts regeneration only if a falsified predicate is a necessary precondition, such as an executable or a file to be read. It permits predicates related to intentional side effects (e.g., files the action aims to create) and diagnostic errors (e.g., missing dependencies within existing test files), blocking test commands only when the test target or runner itself is missing.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在两个层面（结合恢复指令，如图 5 所示）研究 StateMirror 在多大程度上能有效缓解智能体工作流中被检测到的幻觉工具调用。 动作修复关注的是，在受控修订和智能体实际执行两种情况下，一条打字形式的警告能否让智能体用有效动作替换错误动作。 执行前干预关注的是，在错误动作运行之前将其拦截，能否消除该幻觉在任务剩余部分原本会造成的下游代价。 我们以两种模式运行 StateMirror：报告模式（记录每条警告但不拦截）和干预模式（应用保守的拦截规则）。 在干预模式下，只有当被证伪的谓词是必要前置条件（例如一个可执行文件或待读取的文件）时，StateMirror 才会拦截动作并提示重新生成。 它允许与有意副作用相关的谓词（例如动作旨在创建的文件）和诊断性错误相关的谓词（例如现有测试文件中缺失的依赖项），只有当测试目标或测试运行器本身缺失时才拦截测试命令。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate whether agents can correct pending errors given pre-execution feedback, we perform controlled action revision on 100 hallucinated tool calls (sampled evenly across the four agent sources). Each agent receives its pre-action workspace context, the failed action, and StateMirror ’s warning, without any execution feedback. As shown in Table 8 , agents achieve an overall repair rate of 95.0%. Repair rates reach 100% on Honeycomb and SWE-agent, 96.0% on OpenHands, and 84.0% on Sonar. Of the five unrepaired cases, one repeats the warned predicate, and four replace the missing symbol with a sibling name that the package does not export either. Crucially, 88 of the 95 replacements introduce no secondary hallucinations, while only seven surface a new mismatch. Pre-execution detection of these replacements also adds minimal overhead (median 21.5 ms).

paragraphs.en: To evaluate repair in an active agent loop, we deploy StateMirror with SWE-agent across 385 SWE-bench Verified tasks. In report mode, StateMirror audits 3,829 actions and emits 50 warnings across 49 tasks, 46 of which are confirmed by immediate execution failures. Rerunning these 49 tasks in intervention mode yields 46 evaluable events where the hallucination reproduces and triggers blocking. The agent’s very first replacement clears the mismatch and executes successfully in 45 of these 46 cases, achieving a 97.8% live repair rate. This confirms that deterministic pre-execution warnings are highly actionable, allowing agents to preempt execution failures and recover in a single turn.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在主动智能体循环中评估修复效果，我们在 385 个 SWE-bench Verified 任务上部署了 StateMirror 与 SWE-agent。 在报告模式下，StateMirror 审计了 3,829 个动作，并在 49 个任务中发出 50 条警告，其中 46 条被即时的执行失败所证实。 在干预模式下重新运行这 49 个任务，得到 46 个可评估事件，其中幻觉复现并触发阻断。 智能体的首次替换就消除了不匹配，并在 46 个案例中的 45 个里成功执行，达到 97.8% 的实时修复率。 这证实了确定性的执行前警告具有高度可操作性，使智能体能够预先避免执行失败并在单轮内完成恢复。

paragraphs.en: In the intervention cohort, the agent produces a replacement in 78 of the 79 cases before exhausting the budget. The first replacement clears every detected predicate in 73 cases (93.6%), and 66 of those (84.6%) successfully execute with exit code 0. Most non-clears simply repeat the missing dependency through a different command (e.g., an uninstalled numpy ). paragraphs.en: Coding Agent Auditing and Debugging. As interactive coding agents grow more popular, researchers have developed various auditing, debugging, and post-execution repair techniques ( Wang et al., 2026a ; Wang et al., 2026b ) . Traditional debugging and automated repair methods analyze failures after program execution to locate faults or suggest patches ( Zeller and Hildebrandt, 2002 ; Liblit et al., 2005 ; Jones and Harrold, 2005 ; Wong et al., 2016 ; Fan et al., 2023 ; Jiang et al., 2023 ) . Similarly, feedback-driven agent systems run commands and use the resulting runtime tracebacks to correct their actions ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) . Other trajectory analysis frameworks evaluate multi-turn loops to identify failure patterns ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Ma et al., 2024 ; Bouzenia and Pradel, 2025 ; Cemri et al., 2025 ) , or analyze execution trajectories and their prefixes for failure attribution, diagnosis, online detection, and repair ( Zhang et al., 2025a ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Barke et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . While AgentSpec ( Wang et al., 2025a ) can perform pre-execution checks using rules derived from user-specified safety requirements, StateMirror derives factual preconditions from the proposed tool call itself and verifies them through deterministic probes of the current execution environment.
paragraphs.zh: 编码智能体的审计与调试。 随着交互式编码智能体日益流行，研究者们开发了多种审计、调试和执行后修复技术（ Wang et al., 2026a ; Wang et al., 2026b ）。 传统的调试和自动修复方法在程序执行之后分析故障，以定位缺陷或提出补丁（ Zeller and Hildebrandt, 2002 ; Liblit et al., 2005 ; Jones and Harrold, 2005 ; Wong et al., 2016 ; Fan et al., 2023 ; Jiang et al., 2023 ）。 类似地，反馈驱动的智能体系统会运行命令，并利用产生的运行时回溯来纠正自身的行为（ Shinn et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2024 ）。 其他轨迹分析框架评估多轮循环以识别失败模式（ Liu et al., 2023 ; Ma et al., 2024 ; Bouzenia and Pradel, 2025 ; Cemri et al., 2025 ），或分析执行轨迹及其前缀，用于失败归因、诊断、在线检测和修复（ Zhang et al., 2025a ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Barke et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ）。 AgentSpec（ Wang et al., 2025a ）可以基于从用户指定的安全要求中推导出的规则执行执行前检查，而 StateMirror 则从提议的工具调用本身推导事实性前置条件，并通过确定性的探针对当前执行环境进行验证。

paragraphs.en: The post-hoc limitation is particularly evident when dealing with hallucinations in generated code. In language models, hallucination represents output that is unfaithful to a source or to the real world ( Huang et al., 2025 ) . For code generation tasks, these errors often remain hidden until the program actually runs. For example, models frequently generate code that references unpublished packages ( Spracklen et al., 2025 ) or fails during execution ( Zhang et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2025c ; Tian et al., 2025 ) . While existing methods analyze or mitigate errors in finished code snippets ( Jain et al., 2025 ) , they do not check whether the required modules, symbols, and paths are present in the target workspace before running the agent’s next tool call. Post-execution systems generally run actions first and resolve errors using tracebacks, which often increases execution steps and token consumption. In contrast, StateMirror serves as a proactive gate that verifies repository requirements with lightweight, read-only state probes before execution.
paragraphs.zh: 这种事后处理的局限性在处理生成代码中的幻觉问题时尤为明显。 在语言模型中，幻觉指的是对来源或现实世界不忠实的输出（Huang et al., 2025）。 对于代码生成任务，这些错误往往在程序实际运行之前一直处于隐藏状态。 例如，模型经常生成引用未发布包的代码（Spracklen et al., 2025），或在执行过程中失败的代码（Zhang et al., 2025b; Wang et al., 2025c; Tian et al., 2025）。 虽然现有方法可以分析或缓解已完成代码片段中的错误（Jain et al., 2025），但它们不会在运行智能体的下一次工具调用之前检查目标工作区中是否存在所需的模块、符号和路径。 事后执行系统通常先运行动作，再利用回溯信息解决错误，这往往会增加执行步骤和 token 消耗。 相比之下，StateMirror 充当一个主动式的门控，在执行前通过轻量级的只读状态探针来验证仓库需求。

paragraphs.en: Internal threats. To ensure internal validity, we mitigate annotation subjectivity by establishing benchmark labels through independent expert annotations and consensus adjudication. We reconstruct workspace states with high fidelity by replaying verified prefix edits. Furthermore, our evaluation includes both failed and resolved trajectories across four different agent frameworks to minimize framework-specific bias. On the resolved stratum, we observe a lower recall because some errors involve dynamic runtime states rather than static mismatches. Currently, our deterministic predicates prioritize actionable, high-precision static checks. Extending this validation to dynamic, execution-time errors represents an important avenue for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 内部威胁。 为确保内部效度，我们通过独立专家标注与共识裁决建立基准标签，以缓解标注主观性。 我们通过重放已验证的前缀编辑，高保真地重构工作区状态。 此外，我们的评估涵盖了四种不同智能体框架下的失败与已解决轨迹，以尽量减少框架特有的偏差。 在已解决层中，我们观察到较低的召回率，因为某些错误涉及动态运行时状态，而非静态不匹配。 目前，我们的确定性谓词优先考虑可操作、高精度的静态检查。 将这种验证扩展到动态的、执行时错误，是未来工作的重要方向。

paragraphs.en: External threats. While our current empirical evaluation is instantiated on Python bug-fixing tasks, SWE-agent trajectories, and the Qwen3.8-27B model, the StateMirror architecture is designed for broad generalizability. Because it verifies foundational execution assumptions (e.g., filesystem and namespace states) rather than relying on bug-fixing-specific heuristics, its core formulation naturally extends to other coding agents such as code-generation agents and testing agents. Generalizing StateMirror to new programming languages or agent runtimes involves implementing domain-specific predicate extractors and probers, while the overall pre-execution detection workflow remains intact.
paragraphs.zh: 外部威胁。 虽然我们目前的实证评估是基于 Python 缺陷修复任务、SWE-agent 轨迹以及 Qwen3.8-27B 模型进行的，但 StateMirror 架构的设计目标是具备广泛的泛化能力。 由于它验证的是基础的执行前提假设（例如文件系统与命名空间状态），而不依赖于针对缺陷修复的特定启发式方法，因此其核心表述可以自然地扩展到其他智能体，例如代码生成智能体和测试智能体。 将 StateMirror 泛化到新的编程语言或智能体运行时，需要实现特定领域的谓词提取器与探测器，而整体的事前检测工作流程保持不变。

sents.en: While our current empirical evaluation is instantiated on Python bug-fixing tasks, SWE-agent trajectories, and the Qwen3.8-27B model, the StateMirror architecture is designed for broad generalizability.
sents.zh: 虽然我们目前的实证评估是基于 Python 缺陷修复任务、SWE-agent 轨迹以及 Qwen3.8-27B 模型进行的，但 StateMirror 架构的设计目标是具备广泛的泛化能力。

sents.en: Because it verifies foundational execution assumptions (e.g., filesystem and namespace states) rather than relying on bug-fixing-specific heuristics, its core formulation naturally extends to other coding agents such as code-generation agents and testing agents.
sents.zh: 由于它验证的是基础的执行前提假设（例如文件系统与命名空间状态），而不依赖于针对缺陷修复的特定启发式方法，因此其核心表述可以自然地扩展到其他智能体，例如代码生成智能体和测试智能体。

sents.en: Generalizing StateMirror to new programming languages or agent runtimes involves implementing domain-specific predicate extractors and probers, while the overall pre-execution detection workflow remains intact.
sents.zh: 将 StateMirror 泛化到新的编程语言或智能体运行时，需要实现特定领域的谓词提取器与探测器，而整体的事前检测工作流程保持不变。

paragraphs.en: Hallucinated tool use occurs when an agent’s action assumes invalid workspace preconditions. Our preliminary study of 4,398 trajectories reveals these errors are highly prevalent, expensive to recover, and concentrated in filesystem and namespace mismatches. To address this, we present StateMirror , a lightweight pre-execution detector that extracts predicates from actions and deterministically validates them against the live environment. Evaluation on 2,508 actions shows StateMirror achieves 0.940 precision and 0.817 F1, outperforming the strongest LLM judge by 35.3% in F1 with zero token cost and millisecond latency. For practical mitigation, StateMirror enables agents to rectify over 95% of hallucinated tool calls, reducing execution time by 15.8% and token consumption by 11.8% during live intervention.
paragraphs.zh: 幻觉工具使用发生在智能体的动作假设了无效的工作区前置条件时。 我们对 4,398 条轨迹的初步研究表明，这类错误高度普遍、恢复代价高昂，并集中在文件系统与命名空间不匹配上。 为解决这一问题，我们提出 StateMirror，一种轻量级的执行前检测器，它从动作中提取谓词，并根据实时环境对它们进行确定性验证。 在 2,508 个动作上的评估表明，StateMirror 达到 0.940 的精确率和 0.817 的 F1，以零 token 成本和毫秒级延迟，在 F1 上超越最强的 LLM 判官 35.3%。 在实际缓解方面，StateMirror 使智能体能够纠正超过 95% 的幻觉工具调用，在实时干预中将执行时间降低 15.8%，token 消耗降低 11.8%。
